title: TPNCP fixes
description: Fixes for backwards compatibility with pre-7.4 versions.

notes.body:
added 13 commits
  • 99ecf023...ca46d11c - 3 commits from branch wireshark:master
  • 0fa770dc - TPNCP: Initial support for "Since" version
  • 5bdf1dd7 - TPNCP: Manual hook for skipping secondary_rtp_seq_num before 7401
  • 7d197a4c - TPNCP: Improve RtpState resolving
  • 69cf5d6e - TPNCP: Always skip to offset
  • 0417f33c - TPNCP: Exclude ssrc in 1611
  • db0b246e - TPNCP: Skip dtls_remote_fingerprint_alg before 7.4
  • 6c11c6e3 - TPNCP: Do not rely on IP address mark in dat file
  • 8b9ee6ad - TPNCP: Avoid evaluating the same condition twice
  • 859e0957 - TPNCP: Fix exception when data is empty
  • 62f7b6d7 - TPNCP: Update tpncp.dat
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/1537/diffs?diff_id=133704930&start_sha=99ecf02374ac1ea478e314f46df3722c618788e8)
enabled an automatic merge when the pipeline for 62f7b6d7ef43060c4f8ba28be649b1f94df673e8 succeeds
The squashed commit has a bad commit message (it only includes one of the commits). Was it created by gitlab?

Hi,
Yes I beleve so. I'm used to one MR per issue and assumed the commits was leading up to the final commit and should be squashed.
Regards
Anders
Never mind. Thanks for the review :)

commits_data.title: TPNCP: Fix exception when data is empty
commits_data.message:
TPNCP: Fix exception when data is empty

If the actual data is empty, but there is expected data from tpncp.dat,
the subtree should not be created, and the inner dissector should not be
called.

commits_data.title: TPNCP: Avoid evaluating the same condition twice
commits_data.message: TPNCP: Avoid evaluating the same condition twice

commits_data.title: TPNCP: Do not rely on IP address mark in dat file
commits_data.message:
TPNCP: Do not rely on IP address mark in dat file

It is unreliable. Instead, consider the 4 fields after AddressFamily type
as address fields, and show a warning if they don't follow the naming
rules.

commits_data.title: TPNCP: Exclude ssrc in 1611
commits_data.message:
TPNCP: Exclude ssrc in 1611

It is not RtpState

commits_data.title: TPNCP: Always skip to offset
commits_data.message:
TPNCP: Always skip to offset

If the capture is older than the dat file, additional fields will be
filled, and offset needs to go backwards to re-read this memory.

commits_data.message: TPNCP: Manual hook for skipping secondary_rtp_seq_num before 7401

commits_data.title: TPNCP: Initial support for "Since" version
commits_data.message:
TPNCP: Initial support for "Since" version

If a field will set "Since", it will only be displayed if the version
is equal or greater than Since.
